title: AI disaster for banks, super funds and insurers only a matter of time
paragraphs: "There will be interruptions; there will be problems."

That was the warning from the regulator that watches over the nation's banks, superannuation funds and insurers about how artificial intelligence could cause major disruptions to business, consumers and the wider economy.
Every year the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority (APRA) identifies the biggest risks that could cause havoc for financial stability.
